title: SwitchBench-natural v0: exploratory abruptness and operating-point analysis
status: RESULTS (exploratory). Plan committed before any number (6a0765e); deviation X1 (c4fd704) and addition X2 (655503d) logged before the numbers they affect.
banner: EXPLORATORY. Not pre-registered in prereg/, not part of protocol A (prereg/switchbench_natural.md) or 5b. It changes no v0 or v1 verdict, file or code path. Written by builder + reviewer (subagent) on 2026-09-26.
purpose: Anticipate the strongest critique of the v0 headline (tifxyz-doctor catches 6/54 = 0.111 natural switches vs 124/128 = 0.969 planted): (1) 'the gap is definitional: natural switches are gradual, the planted proxy is an abrupt 8-voxel normal offset'; (2) 'it is just the operating point: lower the threshold and it catches them'.

inputs.v0_corpus: data/paris4/corpus/*.json (v0 run, files dated 2026-09-26T05-06Z, unchanged); populations: 54 confirmed events, 115 CT-contradicted candidates, 594 confirmed negative runs (7896.5 mm), 67 scored patches
inputs.v0_hits: results/switchbench_natural_v0.json scored_events (per-event hit flags for 'tifxyz-doctor (coherent-normal-step)' and 'random'), matched to corpus events by (patch, xyz)
inputs.geometry: data/paris4/unverified_patches (the corpus patches), data/paris4/verified_patches (reference cloud, same-lineage exclusion as recorded by v0 per patch)
inputs.detector: tifxyz-doctor aviad12g/tifxyz-doctor @5ca0444 (v0.2.0), public Python API (audit_mesh, load_tifxyz, AuditConfig) run in its own venv ($SWITCHBENCH_EXT (default ./ext)/tifxyz-doctor/.venv); no CLI, no images

probes_before_plan: Timing only: audit_mesh(default) on 2 corpus patches (0.1 s and 1.9 s). No event matching was done.

Doctor score on a synthetic FLAT 40x40 grid (20 vx step) with the doctor's own injector inject_normal_offset_switch: max coherent-normal-step edge score = 0.204 for 8 vx x 1 cell (below the 0.25 candidate threshold: 0 coherent cells), 0.100 for 4 vx x 1, 0.424 for 16 vx x 1 (39 coherent cells), 0.019 for 8 vx x 4 cells, 0.037 for 16 vx x 4, 0.004 for 16 vx x 12. So on a flat sheet the planted 8 vx abrupt proxy scores 0.204; its 124/128 on real patches must come from real-surface roughness along a seam that spans the whole patch. This is checked on the doctor's own 128 holdout patches in A6.

A_abruptness.A1_reproduce_v0_labels: For each member crossing (axis, rc_a, rc_b, delta) of each event: rebuild its grid run (maximal valid stretch of that grid row/column containing rc_a; validity = v0's finite P and finite outward normal), recompute v0 stacks (label.stacks) for every run vertex against the verified cloud (geom.VerifiedIndex.local_cloud over the run's bounding box, pad 160 vx, v0's recorded same-lineage exclusion), v0 assignment (label.assign) and v0 chaining (label.label_run). A member is REPRODUCED if the chain has consecutive segments ending at rc_a and starting at rc_b with the same delta. Non-reproduced members are counted and dropped; events with no reproduced member are counted and excluded from A and B.

A2_member_metrics.W_mm: arc length along the trace (3-D, mm, 9.6 um/vx) from rc_a (last vertex assigned to wrap w, i.e. within 0.25 x local spacing) to rc_b (first vertex assigned to w+/-1); also n_steps (grid steps, one step = 20 vx = 0.192 mm)
A2_member_metrics.gap_vx: A-B sheet separation along rc_b's normal; v0 local spacing s at rc_b
A2_member_metrics.reference_offset: o(i) = distance of vertex i from sheet A toward sheet B along vertex i's outward normal (vx); sheet A tracked forward from rc_a and sheet B backward from rc_b with label.find_in_stack; progress f(i) = o(i) / |tB(i) - tA(i)|
A2_member_metrics.max_step_vx: max |o(i+1) - o(i)| over consecutive vertices from rc_a to rc_b (vx per grid step). If o is undefined at intermediate vertices, the mean per-step change across the undefined stretch is used (a lower bound on its max) and the member is flagged partial
A2_member_metrics.max_rate_vx_per_mm: the same step divided by the 3-D edge length (mm)
A2_member_metrics.intrinsic_doctor_score: tifxyz-doctor's own per-edge coherent-normal-step score (|edge . local normal| / median grid spacing), captured from audit_mesh(default config) without changing its computation, on the run's edges from rc_a-1 to rc_b+1; member max; also in vx (score x the doctor's reference spacing)

A_abruptness.A3_event_level: W_event = median over reproduced members (min also reported); max_step = max over members (median-member value reported as sensitivity); intrinsic = max over members; seam extent = number of member crossings

A4_definitions.ABRUPT_primary: at least one member crossing has a single grid step (one edge, about 0.19 mm) in its transition zone where the reference-relative offset changes by >= 8.0 vx (>= the planted proxy '8 voxels, transition width 1 cell', which moves one side of a seam 8 vx along the normal between two adjacent grid vertices = 41.7 vx/mm). GRADUAL = not ABRUPT.
A4_definitions.s1_median_member: median over members of member max_step >= 8 vx (guards against the max-over-many-members bias)
A4_definitions.s2_width: W_event <= 1 grid step (rc_a and rc_b adjacent)
A4_definitions.s3_intrinsic_planted_level: max doctor edge score in the zone >= 0.20 (the score of the planted 8 vx x 1-cell step on a flat grid, probe above)
A4_definitions.s4_doctor_candidate: max doctor edge score in the zone >= 0.25 (the doctor's default candidate threshold)

A5_report.distributions: n, median, IQR, deciles, min, max of W_event (mm and steps), max_step (vx), max_rate (vx/mm), total offset crossed (vx), intrinsic max score
A5_report.fractions: fraction ABRUPT with Wilson 95% CI under the primary and each sensitivity definition

A_abruptness.A6_planted_yardstick: The doctor's own sealed holdout (128 reviewed same_wrap* patches, IDs from its benchmarks/reviewed-same-wrap-split-v1.json, all on disk), its own injector at offsets {4, 8, 16} vx x widths {1, 4, 12} cells, default config. Report (a) detection by its own rule (new coherent-normal-step cells in the one-cell evaluation band) as a harness check against its published ladder, and (b) the max per-edge score on edges crossing the seam (the same intrinsic yardstick as A2), plus the planted per-step offset profile (from its _transition_coefficients). Natural events are placed on the same axes.

hit_sets: v0 doctor coherent-normal-step hits (CLI examples, v0 D10): 6/54
API mask at the default config (coherent_normal_step_cells, 1 mm matching)
B_hits_vs_abruptness.tables: ABRUPT/GRADUAL x hit/miss for each hit set; recall within each group with Wilson 95% CI; Fisher exact two-sided p for the difference. 'n too small' if a group has n < 10 or its Wilson CI is wider than 0.5
B_hits_vs_abruptness.miss_decomposition: for each event, edges within 1 mm (3-D) of its points: (i) no doctor edge score >= 0.25 (sub-threshold: gradual to the doctor), (ii) candidate edges but the largest 8-connected candidate component touching the zone has < 8 cells, (iii) a coherent component (mask hit)

C_operating_point_sweep.score_exposure: _arrays holds no continuous coherent-normal-step score (only the binary coherent_normal_step_cells mask and the all-cue review_score). The cue's operating point is set by two public AuditConfig parameters (also CLI flags): normal_step_ratio (default 0.25) and normal_step_min_component_cells (default 8). These are swept directly through the API; no proxy is needed.
C_operating_point_sweep.runs: audit_mesh(load_tifxyz(dir), AuditConfig(normal_step_ratio=r, normal_step_min_component_cells=m)) on each of the 67 scored patches for every (r, m); alarms = cells of _arrays['coherent_normal_step_cells']
C_operating_point_sweep.secondary_sweep: any-cue continuous _arrays['review_score'] >= tau, tau in {0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99, 1.0} (default config), plus the default review_cue_mask
C_operating_point_sweep.scoring_v0_rules: alarm points = flagged cell centres (metrics.cells_to_xyz), deduplicated greedily at 0.5 mm in row-major order (v0 evaluate.dedup_alarms semantics, fast equivalent); event hit if any alarm point lies within 1 mm (3-D) of any event point (member transition midpoints + event centroid, v0 D10); false alarms = alarm points within 1 mm of a confirmed negative run's vertices and > 1 mm from every candidate event point of that patch, summed over runs, per 100 mm of confirmed negative length (v0 rule). Secondary FA: fraction of confirmed-negative vertices within 1 mm of an alarm point
C_operating_point_sweep.report: per (r, m): recall (Wilson CI), FA per 100 mm, flagged fraction; best recall at FA <= 1 and <= 5 per 100 mm over the whole grid (ties -> lower FA), with Wilson and patch-block bootstrap CIs (B = 2000, seed 20260925), labeled optimistic (max over the grid, chosen on the test data); the default point (0.25, 8); v0's CLI-example point (6/54, 0.063); recall split ABRUPT/GRADUAL at each point
C_operating_point_sweep.random_baseline_curve: Poisson random alarm points on valid vertices (v0 area rule: 20 vx cells) at 25 log-spaced densities from 0.003 to 10 per mm^2, 20 repetitions each (seeds 20260925 + k), same dedup and scoring; random recall interpolated at the doctor's FA; doctor minus random reported at FA <= 1 and <= 5 per 100 mm
C_operating_point_sweep.validation: the default sweep point must equal the capture run's default mask on every patch; monotonicity (lower r or lower m gives a superset mask) is checked and any violation reported

D_takeaway_rules.claim_G: 'Natural switches are mostly gradual; the planted abrupt proxy does not represent them.' SUPPORTED if the primary ABRUPT fraction's Wilson 95% upper bound < 0.5; CONTRADICTED if its lower bound > 0.5; otherwise UNRESOLVED. Indicative label-noise check: abrupt fraction among true vs false events from a two-group mixture of confirmed (est. precision 0.696) and CT-contradicted candidates (implied est. precision about 0.24 from v0's 0.384 true fraction among 169 decided candidates).
D_takeaway_rules.claim_T: 'No threshold rescues the detector without flooding false alarms.' SUPPORTED if the best recall at FA <= 5 per 100 mm has a Wilson 95% upper bound < 0.5; CONTRADICTED if that best recall is >= 0.5 (point estimate); otherwise UNRESOLVED. Reported alongside: recall at FA <= 1 per 100 mm, doctor minus random at matched FA, and the precision-corrected upper bound (recall / 0.696).
adversarial_checks: measurement noise in reference offsets (step size distribution on confirmed negative runs, where the trace should not move between sheets)
max-over-members bias (ABRUPT fraction by member count; s1)
selection optimism of the best operating point
event clustering (patch-block bootstrap, 10-event patch excluded, cap 3)
FA double counting where row and column runs cross (v0 rule kept, secondary flagged-fraction metric)

limits_to_state: label precision about 0.70 (mixture estimate, not measured)
n = 54 events in 39 patches, one patch holds 10
9.6 um geometry, 20 vx grid step: a step is 0.192 mm, so widths below one step cannot be resolved
exploratory: many sub-analyses, no multiplicity correction
outputs: no images, no ink maps, nothing posted outside the repo; intermediates in the session scratchpad only

deviations_logged_before_full_run.when: 2026-09-26, after a 2-patch smoke test of the geometry code (3 member crossings of 2 confirmed events seen; no distribution computed)
deviations_logged_before_full_run.planned: max_step_vx = max |o(i+1) - o(i)| with o(i) = distance of vertex i from sheet A toward sheet B
deviations_logged_before_full_run.problem: o(i) also grows when sheets A and B diverge while the trace simply follows B (smoke test: A-B gap 9.2 vx at rc_a, 31.9 vx at rc_b), and shrinks when they converge. It mixes trace motion with sheet motion, in either direction.
deviations_logged_before_full_run.change: Add the sheet-frame offset: step_sf = |f(i+1) - f(i)| x mean A-B gap of the two vertices (how far across the inter-sheet gap the trace moves in one grid step), with rate_sf = step_sf / edge length. Both measures are reported side by side. ABRUPT_primary is evaluated under both (8 vx threshold unchanged).
deviations_logged_before_full_run.rule_change: claim_G is SUPPORTED only if supported under both measures, CONTRADICTED only if contradicted under both, otherwise UNRESOLVED. B tables are reported under both.

deviations_logged_before_full_run.when: 2026-09-26, after A6 (the doctor's own holdout ladder) was replicated and before any 20-vx planted number was computed. Already seen at that point: the C sweep numbers, the A6 replication, and the X1 smoke-test values for 3 member crossings (plus a reproduction count for one more patch). Not yet seen: any A or B distribution or table on natural events. (Wording corrected after commit 655503d, which said 'any A or B number'.)
deviations_logged_before_full_run.observation: The doctor's sealed holdout patches (same_wrap*, meta scale 0.08) have a median grid step of 12.6 vx (40 patches: 11.8-13.7). The natural corpus traces (auto_grown, scale 0.05) have a 20.0 vx step. Same voxel frame (9.6 um). The coherent-normal-step score is the edge normal component divided by the median grid step, so one 8 vx step scores about 0.38 on the holdout grid (replicated: median seam max 0.378, 124/128 detected) but about 0.20 on a flat 20 vx grid (probe: 0.204, not detected).
deviations_logged_before_full_run.addition: A6b: the doctor's own ladder (offsets 4, 8, 16 vx x widths 1, 4, 12 cells, its own injector and its own detection rule) on 128 verified auto_grown patches with scale 0.05 (20 vx grid, the natural corpus's resolution), seeded sample (seed 20260925) from those the injector accepts. Detection vs normal_step_ratio (m = 8) from the captured per-edge scores with the doctor's own rule (exactness spot-checked against the API mask at the default). Matched-sensitivity operating point: the largest ratio in the C grid at which the 20-vx planted 8 vx x 1-cell detection is >= 124/128; natural recall and FA at that point are read from the C sweep.
deviations_logged_before_full_run.effect_on_rules: None on claim_G / claim_T rules. The matched-sensitivity point is reported as the fair natural-vs-planted comparison at equal mesh resolution; the published 124/128 stays the v0 comparison value.

planted_yardstick.note: detected_replicated counts new coherent-normal-step cells only; the published gradual rows (x4, x12 cells) count any new cue, so small differences there are expected; the abrupt rows match exactly (124/128 and 128/128)
